scenario: Integers are 64-bit signed per LDET.6.3.1 — overflow wraps in two's complement. Pin: INT64_MAX + 1 wraps to INT64_MIN (-9223372036854775808). Rule fires when the wrapped result equals the expected negative value.
rules_ds:
schema Big scope logical:
    n: Int key

rule r:
    Big b where b.n + 1 == -9223372036854775808
->
    log info "wrapped"
